msContents.summary: A Malayalam manuscript of the Mahābhārata Āraṇyakaparvan.

lg.l: jaḷāñ copajaḷāñ caiva yumunām abhito nadīṃ
uśīnaro vai yatreṣṭvā vāsavād atiricyate
tān devasamitis tasya vāsavaś ca viśāṃ pate

abhyagacśata rājānaṃ jñātum agni
ś ca bhārata
jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmānam uśīnaraṃ
indra śyenaḥ kapoto gniḥ bhūtvā yajñe bhijagmatuḥ
ūruṃ rājñas samāsādya kapota śyenajād bhayāt

body.p: ❈ ity āraṇyake triṃśacśatatamo śrīmahābhārate āraṇyakaparvaṇi triṃśacśatatamo dhyāyaḥ | ❈

lg.l: dharmmātmānan tv āhur ekaṃ sarvve rājan mahīkṣitaḥ
sa vai dharmmaviruddhaṃ tvaṃ kasmāt_ karmma cikīrṣasi
vihitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ rājan_ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā
mā bhāṃkṣī dharmmalobhena dharmmam utsṛjyamān aśīḥ |

santrastarūpas trāṇā
rtthī tvatto bhīto mahādvija
matsakāśam anuprātaḥ prāṇagṛddhnur ayan dvijaḥ
evam abhyāgatasyeha kapotasyābhayārtthinaḥ |
apradānaṃ paro dharmmaḥ kin tvaṃ śyeneha paśyasi |

praspandamānas saṃbhrāntaḥ kapota śyena la
kṣyate
matsakāśañ jīvitārtthī tasya tyāgo vigārhitaḥ |
āhārāt sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti mahīpate
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ

śakyate puṣkalasyārtthe cirarātrāya jīvi
tuṃ
na tu bhojanam utsṛjya śakyaṃ varttayituñ ciraṇ |
bhakṣād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate
visṛjya kāyam eṣyanti panthānam apunarbhavaṃ
pramṛte mayi dharmmātman putradāra naśiṣyati

rakṣamānaḥ ka
potan tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān nariṣyasi
bandrasyo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaḥ kuvartma tat_
avirodhī tu yo dharmma sa dharmmas satyavikramaḥ
virodhiṣu mahīpāla niścitya gurulāghavaṃ

na bādhā vidyate yatra
tad dharmmaṃ samudācara
gurulāghavam ajñāya dharmmātmādharmaniścaye
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmmaviniścayaṃ |
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama

suparṇṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ kin tvaṃ dharmmaṃ
jñaś cābhibhāṣase
tathā hi dharmmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ vibhāṣase
na te sty aviditaṃ kiñcid iti tvā lakṣayāmy ahaṃ
śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ parityāgaṃ kathaṃ sāddhv iti manyase
āhārārtthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama

śakyaś cāpy anya
thā karttum āhāro bhyadhikās tvayā
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mahiṣo vā mṛgo pi vā
tvadarttham atra kriyatāṃ yad vānyad abhikāṃkṣase |
na varāvin na cokṣāṇan na mṛgān vividhāṃs tathā

bhakṣayāmi mahārāja kim annād ye
na tena me
yas tu me devavihito bhakṣan_ kṣatriyapuṃgava
tam utsṛjya mahīpāla kapotam imam eva me
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādanti sthitir eṣā sanātanī
mā rājan mārggam ājñāya kadalīstaṃdham āsajaḥ |

rājyaṃ śibī
nām ṛddhaṃ vai śādhi pakṣibhir arccitaḥ
kṛtsnam etan mayā dattaṃ rājavadvihagottama
yad vā kāmayase kin tu śyena sarvvan dadāni te
vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārtthinam āgataṃ
yenemaṃ sthāvayethās tvaṃ karmmaṇā pakṣisattama

tadā
cakṣva kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotakaṃ |
uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipa
ātmamāṃsam samuddhṛtya kapotatulayā dhṛtaṃ
yadā samaṃ kapotena tava māṃsaṃ bhaven nṛpa
tadā pradeyan tan mahyaṃ sā me tuṣṭir bhaviṣyati ||
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan māhiyācase
tasmāt te sya pradāsyāmi svamāṃsan tulayā dhṛtaṃ |
athot_kṛtya svamāṃsan tu rājā paramadharmmavit_
tulayāmāsa kaunteya keapotena sahābhibho

dhriyamā
ṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyata
punaś cot_kṛtya māṃsāni rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samāvṛtaṃ
tata ut_kṛttamāṃso vāruroha svayan tulāṃ |

indro ham asmi dharmmajña
kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ
jijñāsamāno dharmme tvāṃ yajñavāṭam upāgatau
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhya ut_kṛttāni viśāṃ pate
eṣā te bhāsvarā kīrttir llokān abhigamiṣyati

yāval loke manuṣyās tvāṃ ka
thayiṣyanti pārthiva
tāvat_ kīrttiś ca lokāś ca sthāsyanti tava śāśvatāḥ
tat_ pāṇḍaveya sadanaṃ rājñas tasya mahātmanaḥ
paśyat vai tan mayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanīṃ

atraiva satatan devā munaya
ś ca tapodhanāḥ
dṛśyante brāhmaṇo rājan_ puṇyakṛtbhir mmahāprataiḥ |
